_about: Sound roles for every reel. whoosh, land, click, impact, pop, ding and riser are DVE's own sounds, synthesized by scripts/make_sounds.py: yours to use anywhere. Swap a role for your own licensed file, or set it to null for no sound. music_beds: YOUR licensed beds (paths under sounds/music/), ducked under the voice. music_under_voice_lu: how far the bed sits under the voice.
